results.title: A Dessert for Constance
results.overview: Bokolo and Mamadou, sweepers in the city of Paris, are looking for a way to pay for the return home of one of their sick comrades. When they find an old book of recipes in the trash, they discover a passion for French cuisine and decide to participate in a televised cooking competition.

results.title: The Second Kind
results.overview: 1976. Following the mysterious disappearance of his wife, a grief-stricken father spirals into self-destruction along the deserted highways of California, until an encounter with strange lights in the sky changes everything.

results.title: Right in Front of You
results.overview: A struggling widow has less than two weeks to save her home. As romance blossoms, a shocking secret threatens her last chance at a fresh start.

results.title: What Waits Beyond
results.overview: The story of Nea, a young woman who after an attempt on her life, finds herself in a land between life and the afterlife. Discovering that she is not alone here she must make a decision. Keep on running, or face what waits beyond...

results.title: Artificial Ignorance
results.overview: When a young man turns to an AI android for companionship, he dismisses odd quirks and uncovers the terrifying reality of this android’s origin.

results.title: Petticoat
results.overview: After an unraveling in front of her entire family, a young South Asian woman resorts to disturbing measures to restore what's been undone.

results.title: The Faust Bible: How Murnau Made Magic
results.original_title: The Faust Bible: How Murnau Made Magic
results.overview: The groundbreaking visual effects of F.W. Murnau’s FAUST have remained shrouded in mystery since its release 100 years ago. Now, the publication of a long-lost book assembled by the filmmaker’s closest collaborators has revealed the spectacular secrets of this expressionist masterpiece. Utilising a trove of newly-unearthed sketches and on-set photographs, this exclusive Program Notes short documentary by Amos Levin and Ben Porro explores the artistic vision and technical wizardry behind the film’s most astonishing sequence: the flight around the world.

results.title: Dare To Do Right!
results.overview: An observational documentary follows four twenty-year-old missionaries from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints who come to live in the Balkans for two years. In the heart of secular Slovenia, they attempt to find new converts on the streets, all while living under strict rules: they are not allowed to listen to music, have limited access to the internet, and must never separate from one another.

results.title: Portrait
results.overview: A lonely old man invites a male escort to his home in a last stitch effort to live the life he was too scared to live.

results.title: Ultimatum
results.overview: Juni realizes that Martin can no longer stand her. He wants her to undergo an assessment, while she feels that he is putting her in an impossible situation.

results.title: Cold Blooded Kari
results.overview: Follows Minneapolis ultra winter athlete Kari Gibbons on her journey toward the legendary 1,000 mile Iditarod Trail Invitational on foot. Driven by an obsession with winter and the pursuit of endurance, Kari has become a respected leader in the growing community of female ultra winter athletes. Through intimate access and breathtaking landscapes, the film explores the grit, purpose, and resilience required to chase one of the toughest endurance goals on Earth.

results.title: Like Fire
results.overview: A short film based on the poem of the same name. A woman relives the ardent and haunting memories of a lost love that she wants to forget.

results.title: Two Prayers
results.overview: A Muslim man seeks a new place to pray, leading him to the local church.

results.title: Shiina Ringo: Reiwa 8 Nationwide Tour
results.original_title: 椎名林檎 党大会 令和八年列島巡回
results.overview: Filmed at Tokyo's Sumida Triphony Hall on May 1, 2026, this concert captures Shiina Ringo with an exceptional ensemble of band musicians, a horn section, and a string quartet. Across a full-length performance from her Reiwa 8 Tootaikai tour, the arrangements balance precise detail with expansive live energy. The concert film brings the stage to cinema screens in stereo and Dolby Atmos, letting audiences experience the music with theatrical scale and sound.

results.title: Emiray: Macera Yolcusu
results.overview: A group of children playing in a library assemble a "Kündekâri" puzzle found in a package they receive. Completing the puzzle opens a time tunnel, sending the group to different locations. Emiray, Karaca, and Fatma go to a forested area inhabited by giants, while Zekai and Ruhi join a caravan journey in the desert. Set during Mevlana Celaleddin Rumi's childhood, these children, scattered to different places, try to understand the workings of their new dimension and solve the puzzle's loop to return to their own time.
